title: ApiKey lookalikes, placeholders and prose
summary: Bare ApiKey prose, a scheme-only header, placeholders, environment references and masked values after the ApiKey scheme.
rationale: The word ApiKey names a scheme and is also an everyday term, so prose or a header with no value is not a credential, and a placeholder, reference or masked display carries no value.

expectation.rationale: Not flagged under project policy: these inputs hold no credential value. That a placeholder or reference is not a value is a project decision, not an Elastic statement.

sources.supports: You must create an API key and use the encoded value in the request header: Authorization: ApiKey ${API_KEY}

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed. All values are synthetic, were built for this record and were not tested against any service. The carrier's existence is what the cited provider pages document; the value admission, span, placeholder handling and attribution are project policy.
